es.english: We have finally left Madrid,
Did you lock the door?

es.es: Sí, lo he comprobado tres veces
es.english: Yes, I checked three times

es.es: ¿Y tú, has avisado en tu trabajo?
es.english: And you, have you informed your work?
es.ipa: [i tu as aβiˈsaðo en tu tɾaˈβaxo]

es.english: Yes, I sent an email last night.
How do you feel?

es.es: Me siento libre y un poco nervioso. ¿Es raro, verdad?
es.english: I feel free and a bit nervous. It's strange, right?
es.ipa: [me ˈsjento ˈliβɾe i un ˈpoko nerˈβjoso es ˈraɾo βeɾˈðað]

es.es: Yo también, es normal. Estamos cambiando toda nuestra vida.
es.english: Me too, it's normal. We are changing our entire life.
es.ipa: [ʝo tamˈbjen es norˈmal esˈtamos kamˈβjando ˈtoða ˈnwes.tɾa ˈβiða]

es.english: Look at the landscape, it's beautiful!

es.es: He traído bocadillos. De queso y jamón.
es.english: I've brought sandwiches. Cheese and ham.
es.ipa: [e tɾaˈiðo βokaˈðiʎos de ˈkeso i xaˈmon]

es.english: Great idea, I'm hungry.
How long is the trip?

es.es: Unas cinco horas. Llegaremos sobre las cuatro.
es.english: About five hours. We'll arrive around four.
es.ipa: [ˈunas ˈθiŋko ˈoɾas ʎeɣaˈɾemos ˈsoβɾe las ˈkwatɾo]

es.english: Oh no! I forgot my book!
It's okay, we can talk.
What do you want to talk about?

es.es: Sobre nuestros sueños y nuestro futuro
es.english: About our dreams and our future

es.es: ¿Qué es lo que realmente quieres en la vida?
es.english: What do you really want in life?
es.ipa: [ke es lo ke reˈalmen̩te ˈkjeɾes en la ˈβiða]

es.english: That's a big question
I want to feel alive, I think.

es.es: El metro corre por el campo madrileño.
es.english: The metro runs through the Madrid countryside.
es.ipa: [el ˈmetɾo ˈkoɾe por el ˈkampo maðɾiˈleɲo]

es.es: Sophie y Lucas miran el paisaje que pasa por la ventana.
es.english: Sophie and Lucas watch the landscape passing by the window.
es.ipa: [ˈsofi i ˈlukas ˈmiɾan el pajˈsaxe ke ˈpasa por la βenˈtana]

es.english: says Sophie, almost in disbelief.
Lucas checks his phone.
Sophie turns towards Lucas.

es.es: El paisaje se vuelve más montañoso.
es.english: The landscape becomes more mountainous.

es.es: Comen en silencio, admirando la vista.
es.english: They eat in silence, admiring the view.
